items.title: Ladislav Krejčí (footballer, born 1992)
items.summary: Ladislav Krejčí is a Czech professional footballer. He plays as a left-winger for Teplice. He played for the Czech Republic national team between 2012 and 2019, where he scored five goals in 41 matches, and was part of their team at the 2016 UEFA European Championship.
